entries.aae51f526cfee71d: Under its Medium-term Management Plan (fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2028), the 'New Five-Year Plan', it sets as its target state 'a leading company representing the foundation construction industry with a high degree of specialization.' Its business strategy is to strengthen the competitiveness of existing businesses by shifting toward large-diameter and large-scale construction, to build a structure for achieving top share in all pile types and developing new market areas, and to pursue technological innovation in Japan and overseas market development. It has also formulated a sustainability strategy that advances measures such as responses to climate change and the realization of workplaces that are easy to work in. Under the holding company structure, it also indicates a policy of expanding its foundation construction business from the domestic market to the ASEAN market.
